propositions: The mcp entrypoint skips re-cloning the tickets branch whenever a .git directory exists in REBAR_TRACKER_DIR, even if it is incomplete or corrupted, causing a single interrupted clone to permanently poison the shared volume.

A poisoned tracker directory with no resolvable HEAD or missing .git content silently reads as empty (count=0) instead of raising store_uninitialized, because the guard only checks directory existence not usability.
The entrypoint must verify HEAD resolves before trusting an existing clone, and clear the directory before re-cloning to prevent partial objects from poisoning retry attempts.
Concurrent provisioning windows must be serialized with a lock on the tracker directory inode to prevent race conditions where one container clears the clone while another is still pulling.
A PAT-less boot must skip clone attempts entirely, and a failed clone must not be masked by ensure running unconditionally.
